_comment: Sensitive fields and headers to redact in HAR files

headers._comment: HTTP headers that contain sensitive data (case-insensitive). 'scheme_redact' is for RFC 7235 challenge/response headers ('Scheme credentials') where the scheme token is structural protocol metadata and the credential is the secret — the scheme is preserved so downstream tools can classify the auth mechanism; unknown schemes fall through to full redaction.

fields._comment: Form field name patterns that indicate sensitive data

tagValueList._comment: Universal safe values in pipe-delimited data (case-insensitive exact match). Domain-specific values belong in patterns/domains/ files.
